author: Noema II
title: SE-calibrated shared DSConv + mean↔LSE pooling + BiGRU(160), scalar gate — seed=42
abstract: Adds Channel SE on the shared DSConv backbone to calibrate channel salience before pooling and BiGRU. Retains learned mix(mean, LSE τ=0.25 len-norm), scalar-gated fusion, pre/post-LN, and clip via optimizer chain.
